reviews.text:
I’ve been using this product for a while now and honestly I’m really impressed with the results. The texture feels very smooth and lightweight on the skin, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling behind. It gives the skin a healthy, hydrated glow and makes it feel softer and fresher after each use.

What I liked the most is that it feels gentle and comfortable on the skin, even with regular use. It did not cause irritation or breakouts for me, and over time I noticed my skin looking more balanced, smoother, and healthier overall. The packaging is also practical and easy to use, and a little product goes a long way.

I think this is a great skincare product for daily use, especially for people looking for something effective, hydrating, and easy to include in their routine. Overall, I had a very positive experience with it and would definitely recommend trying it.
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢款產品一段時間，老實講，我對效果真係好滿意。質地好順滑、輕盈，吸收得好快，唔會留低任何油膩或者黏膩嘅感覺。佢令皮膚有健康、水潤嘅光澤，用完之後感覺更加柔軟、清爽。

最令我鍾意嘅係，佢用落去感覺好溫和舒適，即使經常使用都冇令我刺激或者爆痘。久而久之，我發現皮膚睇落更加平衡、更加順滑、更加健康。包裝都好實用、易用，而且只需要少少份量就夠。

我覺得呢款係一款好好嘅日常護膚產品，尤其啱想要有效、補水、容易融入護膚程序嘅人。整體嚟講，我嘅體驗好正面，一定會推薦畀大家試吓。

reviews.text: I am really enjoying using this gel. Sadly it seems to be discontinued, I would really need to have something like this on my shelf constantly. It is a calming thick gel, great texture, not sticky at all, have some cooling features. My skin feels hydrated, protected, calm, doesn’t get oily during the day. Amazing option for summer, when any cream seems too heavy.
reviews.zh: 我真係好享受用呢款凝膠。可惜佢好似已經停產咗，我真係好需要長期喺櫃入面有啲咁嘅產品。佢係一款舒緩嘅厚身凝膠，質地好好，唔會粘，有啲清涼嘅效果。我嘅皮膚感覺水潤、受到保護、平靜，日間都唔會出油。夏天嘅好選擇，尤其係乜嘢面霜都好似太厚嗰時。

reviews.text: I tried it for the first time and love it. I put it on after Riddle Shots and Adapalene 0.1% gel. It's good for my night routine, but I use it in the morning too because I ran out of moisturizer, and sometimes I like gel more than cream. It's good for my combination skin. Doesn't damage and isn't sticky.
reviews.zh: 我第一次試就好鍾意。我喺 Riddle Shots 同 0.1% Adapalene 凝膠之後塗呢款。佢啱我晚上護膚程序，不過因為我面霜用完咗，所以朝早都用，而且有時我鍾意凝膠多過面霜。佢啱我混合性皮膚。唔會傷害皮膚，亦唔會黏。

reviews.text: i have used the cleanser from this brand and decided to try out other products. so glad i bought this moisturizer. it is fungal acne safe !!! i thought the gel consistency might not be moisturizing enough but i personally think it feels thick (in a good way). might b better for summer but winter is just as nice ! love it. it sits well under makeup too
reviews.zh: 我之前用過呢個品牌嘅潔面，所以決定試吓其他產品。好高興我買咗呢款保濕霜。佢係真菌痘安全嘅！！！我本以為凝膠質地可能唔夠滋潤，但係我個人覺得佢感覺厚身（而且係好嘅方面）。可能夏天更適合，但係冬天都一樣好！好鍾意。化妝底下都好好。

reviews.text: What I love about this gel is how instantly soothing it feels — perfect when my skin is a bit stressed or irritated. The texture is light and refreshing, absorbing quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. It really calms down redness and gives a nice, cool sensation. After using it regularly, my skin looks more balanced and feels more comfortable. Overall, this is a calming gem I turn to when I want gentle relief without compromising hydration.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意呢款凝膠嘅地方，就係佢即時就有舒緩嘅感覺——皮膚有少少壓力或者刺激嗰時，最啱用。質地輕盈、清爽，吸收快，唔會覺得黏或者厚重。佢真係可以減低紅位，又有好舒服嘅涼感。定期用咗之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更加平衡，感覺更加舒服。總括嚟講，呢款係一款舒緩寶物，當我想溫和舒緩，又唔想犧牲補水嗰時，我就會搵佢。

reviews.text: This is actually my second purchase. When my skin is fully inflamed and I don’t want to add more oily products, I use this to help prevent further acne, and it really works. It moisturizes lightly and has a gel-like texture. I wouldn’t recommend it for dry skin, but it’s great for oily, acne-prone skin.
reviews.zh: 呢次其實係我第二次買。當我皮膚發炎得好嚴重，又唔想加多油性產品嗰時，我就用呢款嚟幫助預防進一步爆痘，真係有效。佢保濕力輕，質地似凝膠。我唔會推薦畀乾性皮膚，但係對油性、易生暗瘡嘅皮膚嚟講好好。

reviews.text: my sister has oily acne prone skin nothing has helped her soothe and moisturize her face better then this one it’s the best calming gel I’ll say it helped her reduce her acne and calm her face as she goes to school in this hot weather she comes back washes her face and applies this helps her calm her face and reduce the oily feeling definitely will purchase again
reviews.zh: 我嘅 sister 皮膚油，又易生暗瘡，冇咩產品可以比呢款更有效咁幫佢舒緩同滋潤面部。我話呢個係最好嘅舒緩凝膠，佢幫佢減少咗暗瘡，令面部平靜落嚟。佢喺呢個熱天返學，返到屋企洗完面之後，塗呢款就可以幫佢平靜面部，減低油膩感。一定會再買。

reviews.text: This calming gel is a lifesaver for irritated skin. It feels cool and refreshing upon application, instantly calming redness and reducing sensitivity. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated without any stickiness. I use it as a daily moisturizer, and it’s been a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. Highly recommended!
reviews.zh: 呢款舒緩凝膠對於受刺激嘅皮膚嚟講係救星。塗上去感覺清涼、清爽，即時舒緩紅位，減低敏感。吸收快，用完令皮膚感覺柔軟、水潤，冇任何黏膩。我將佢當日常保濕霜用，係我護膚程序入面一個好好嘅新增產品。強烈推薦！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
